Acme Logistics

Acme Logistics builds freight visibility software for mid-market shippers. Our platform ingests carrier EDI feeds, GPS telematics and port terminal events, normalises them into a single shipment timeline, and tells operations teams which loads are about to miss their delivery window. We process roughly four million tracking events a day for around three hundred customers across North America and Western Europe.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Rotterdam, with engineering split between Rotterdam and Toronto. We are a team of about ninety people, thirty-four of them in engineering.
